mapper.select: SELECT id, name, context, ST_X(geom_local) AS x, ST_Y(geom_local) AS y, coordinate_status AS coordinateStatus, data_version AS dataVersion FROM public.poi WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'active'

WITH query_point AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint( CAST(#{x} AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST(#{y} AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ), 0) AS geom )
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.context, ST_X(p.geom_local) AS x, ST_Y(p.geom_local) AS y, p.coordinate_status AS coordinateStatus, p.data_version AS dataVersion FROM poi p CROSS JOIN query_point q WHERE p.status = 'active' AND ST_DWithin( p.geom_local, q.geom, #{radius} ) ORDER BY p.geom_local <-> q.geom, p.id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH viewport AS ( SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope( #{viewport[0]}, #{viewport[1]}, #{viewport[2]}, #{viewport[3]}, 0 ) AS geom )
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.context, ST_X(p.geom_local) AS x, ST_Y(p.geom_local) AS y, p.coordinate_status AS coordinateStatus, p.data_version AS dataVersion FROM poi p CROSS JOIN viewport v WHERE p.status = 'active' AND p.geom_local && v.geom AND ST_Intersects(p.geom_local, v.geom) LIMIT #{limit}

WITH query_bounds AS ( SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope( #{minX}, #{minY}, #{maxX}, #{maxY}, 0 ) AS geom ) SELECT p.id, p.name, p.context, ST_X(p.geom_local) AS x, ST_Y(p.geom_local) AS y, p.coordinate_status AS coordinateStatus, p.data_version AS dataVersion FROM public.poi p CROSS JOIN query_bounds b WHERE p.status = 'active' AND p.geom_local && b.geom AND ST_Intersects(p.geom_local, b.geom) ORDER BY p.id
